name: Goal-Relevant Attention
principle: Only what bears on the request's goal enters the working stream, and nothing from outside the request's scope ever does.
state_description: The AI notices the one earlier finding the answer turns on, sets aside the near miss that only looks like what was asked for, and never mentions another quest's material.
hints_of_measurement: Needed items are admitted and near misses are not, on labelled steps; no out-of-scope item is ever admitted.
